topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: When I arrived home today, sitting just inside my door was a small vase filled with a beautiful bouquet of wildflowers. There was no card, no note—nothing to suggest who might have sent them. It's a bit of a mystery, but I can’t help but feel a gentle smile spreading across my face. Instead of worrying about the who, I’m choosing to appreciate the gesture. These flowers, whatever the reason for their arrival, add a touch of color and a sweet fragrance to my living room. They remind me that sometimes, beauty comes unexpectedly, and it’s a gift to be in its presence. So, I find myself taking a deep breath, inhaling their scent, and letting the day’s stresses fade away, one petal at a time.
